lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 10 distinct high-contrast vertical lines. Spacing is relatively equidistant across the mid-torso, with slightly increased density in the anterior shoulder region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Posterior-most line is a truncated dash segment. Three anterior lines terminate mid-flank before reaching the ventral line of the torso. Line 7 and 8 (counting from posterior) show fragmentation near the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two high-contrast spots located on the posterior flank above the hind limb joint; one spot on the mid-haunch.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the lower posterior flank align on a horizontal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dark irregular pigmentation spots on the interior pinna of the right ear.
other_distinctive_markers: White chevron marking on muzzle; two white spots on the cheek; white transverse band across the lower neck/throat; white patches on lower limbs (socks) above the hooves.
